# Intrinsic Technology

> Intrinsic Technology is a women-owned and minority-owned managed service provider (MSP) headquartered in New York City. We provide Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Cloud, and AI services—engineered, monitored, and secured for business—with 24/7 monitoring, complete accountability, and one trusted technology partner. We serve healthcare, financial services, legal and professional services, construction, and non-profit organizations across New York, New Jersey, Boston, and Washington, D.C.
